facts.text: The Buffalo Promise Scholarship automatically covers 100% of the cost of tuition after any government aid for up to four years of undergraduate education for eligible students from the Buffalo area.

sources.title: Canisius Buffalo Promise Scholarship
sources.quote: This award automatically covers 100% of the cost of tuition after any government aid for up to four years of undergraduate education at Canisius for eligible accepted students from the Buffalo area.

facts.text: The New York Promise Scholarship covers 100% of undergraduate tuition for up to four years for first-year students beginning in fall 2027.

sources.title: Canisius Expands Promise Scholarship Initiative Across New York ...
